adversary.name: Adversary
adversary.description: Adversary Knacks let you understand a person’s weakness and turn it against them, whether to destroy them or force them to change. Adversary knacks are based around opposition and betrayal.

architect.name: Architect
architect.description: Many have lamented tragedies that foreknowledge might have prevented, but only a few among those blessed (or cursed) to know Fate’s workings have the will to turn aside what otherwise will be.

automachy.description: These Automachy Knacks gift Scions with specific aptitudes regarding different aspects of automobiles. Since they are relatively new, it’s possible other such Knacks haven’t been discovered yet.

collector.description: Collector Knacks improve your ability to gather and curate your hoard, as well as focusing your mind on commerce and numbers. They are driven by the concepts of ownership and analytics.

covenant.name: Covenant
covenant.description: Some Gods — and thus, some Scions — belong to no pantheon and possess no Pantheon Signature Purview. They can instead substitute a Covenant for some of the benefits of belonging to a pantheon.
covenant.mechanicalEffects: Some Gods — and thus, some Scions — belong to no pantheon and possess no Pantheon Signature Purview. They can instead substitute a Covenant for some of the benefits of belonging to a pantheon.

creator.name: Creator
creator.description: Creator Knacks enhance your ability to craft, shape, and even destroy things. Creator Knacks are driven by the concepts of building and shaping. Keep in mind that the crafting rules don’t necessarily apply to material objects but to plans and other esoteric effects. Creator Knacks can apply to these as well — Reverse Engineer applies to computer code just as well as car engines.

druid.name: Druid
druid.description: Originally the priests of the Nemetondevos, the druids took their great knowledge of the World elsewhere after the Romans conquered Gaul.
druid.mechanicalEffects: Originally the priests of the Nemetondevos, the druids took their great knowledge of the World elsewhere after the Romans conquered Gaul.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: Guardian Knacks gift you with the vast fortitude and sharp senses, to better protect those you have sworn to guard. Guardian Knacks are driven by the concepts of durability and protection. Guardian Knacks revolve around choosing a specific person to protect. guardian.mechanicalEffects: Guardian Knacks gift you with the vast fortitude and sharp senses, to better protect those you have sworn to guard. Guardian Knacks are driven by the concepts of durability and protection. Guardian Knacks revolve around choosing a specific person to protect. When choosing who is worth of your divine protection, bear in mind that — unless they’ve completely neglected to invest in any sort of combat abilities — your bandmates do not need you to be the wall between them and your enemies. They should, for the most part, be able to handle that themselves. This is not to say that the Storyguide should forbid you from using these abilities on your bandmates, especially when it would be cool or dramatic, but that the intent is that a Guardian Scion protects those who are weaker than herself.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: Healer Knacks improve your ability to heal and help your allies with mundane medicines. Healer Knacks are driven by the concepts of purification and restoration.
healer.mechanicalEffects: Healer Knacks improve your ability to heal and help your allies with mundane medicines. Healer Knacks are driven by the concepts of purification and restoration.

herald.name: Herald
herald.description: Heralds immerse themselves in the current of destiny, for they are ensnared and can’t imagine existence without the focus of that destiny.
herald.mechanicalEffects: Heralds immerse themselves in the current of destiny, for they are ensnared and can’t imagine existence without the focus of that destiny.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: Hunter Knacks improve your ability to pursue and track a target and avoid detection when on the hunt. Hunter Knacks are driven by the concepts of pursuit and perception against a single target, called the quarry. Like Creator Knacks, Hunter Knacks do not need a literal stalked target. Figurative stalking — be it chasing down a malevolent Kami hidden in construction blueprints or pursuing a black hat hacker through a…
hunter.mechanicalEffects: Hunter Knacks improve your ability to pursue and track a target and avoid detection when on the hunt. Hunter Knacks are driven by the concepts of pursuit and perception against a single target, called the quarry. Like Creator Knacks, Hunter Knacks do not need a literal stalked target. Figurative stalking — be it chasing down a malevolent Kami hidden in construction blueprints or pursuing a black hat hacker through a mainframe. So long as there is opposition, it’s sufficient for Hunters to pursue. Some Hunter Knacks refer to a hunting ground. This can be any place that the hunter has familiarized themselves with in detail, through either a day’s worth of free and casual inspection or a dramatic scene dedicated to learning the place’s true nature.

judge.name: Judge
judge.description: Judge Knacks give you power over laws, rules, and the truth. They are driven by the concepts of ordinance and judgment. ENFORCER’S EYE When observing a crowd or another group of characters (such as assembled personages at a party), you automatically identify anyone with a criminal background. Gain +1 Enhancement to any actions taken to either further pursue their criminal activities, or to bring them to justice. If…
judge.mechanicalEffects: Judge Knacks give you power over laws, rules, and the truth. They are driven by the concepts of ordinance and judgment. ENFORCER’S EYE When observing a crowd or another group of characters (such as assembled personages at a party), you automatically identify anyone with a criminal background. Gain +1 Enhancement to any actions taken to either further pursue their criminal activities, or to bring them to justice. If the target is of a Tier higher than you or is concealing their identity via magic, make a Clash of Wills.

knight.name: Knight
knight.description: Knights of the Round Table are recruited as agents of the new king, serving him when they hear of his actions. Such warriors swear themselves to the service to other worthy causes or individuals until Avalon calls.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: Leader Knacks grant you the power to hold sway over your followers and keep order in the midst of chaos. Leader Knacks are driven by the concepts of charisma and control. This section references characters that “follow” the Leader Scion. Followers are typically not bandmates, and are often trivial targets (though not necessarily). Use this as a metric for determining whether or not a character is a follower.

liminal.name: Liminal
liminal.description: Liminal Knacks at the mortal level grant you the power to send messages, to ease your travels, and to draw upon the silence at the edges of mortal perception. Liminal Knacks are driven by the concepts of boundary and distance.

lover.name: Lover
lover.description: Lover Knacks bestow upon you domain over relationships, attention, and other’s emotions. Lover Knacks are driven by the concepts of emotion and relationships.
lover.mechanicalEffects: Lover Knacks bestow upon you domain over relationships, attention, and other’s emotions. Lover Knacks are driven by the concepts of emotion and relationships.

miracleworker.name: Miracle Worker
miracleworker.description: Some Prophets learn to use Fate itself as a tool, reworking its strands and thereby allowing them to produce wonders. These Miracleworkers do the impossible, turning existence itself into a weapon against their enemies and a wonder to awe and terrify their fellow mortals.

monster.name: Monster
monster.description: Monster Knacks unleash your inner beast, often transforming your flesh to match. They are powered by the concepts of transformation and predation. Characters with any dots in Monster gain access to a Monstrous Urge — a condition that reflects the beast that dwells within them. You can activate your Monstrous Urge anytime you are injured, threatened, or embarrassed.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.description: All Prophets can see the inherent workings of Fate, but some go beyond even such miraculous heights. Oracles peer deep into Fate without obstruction, interpreting the swirls of information that Fate provides.

predator.description: Predator Knacks make you an unparalleled hunter, capable of stalking the most dangerous prey. They are driven by the concepts of stealth and killing.
predator.mechanicalEffects: Predator Knacks make you an unparalleled hunter, capable of stalking the most dangerous prey. They are driven by the concepts of stealth and killing.

primeval.name: Primeval
primeval.description: The most esoteric of the Callings, Primeval Knacks allow you to inhabit an aspect of the World: the oceans, a tsunami, a storm, etc. They are driven by the concepts of embodiment and environment. A DRAGON’S TERRITORY The Field you are fighting in becomes your territory. primeval.mechanicalEffects: The most esoteric of the Callings, Primeval Knacks allow you to inhabit an aspect of the World: the oceans, a tsunami, a storm, etc. They are driven by the concepts of embodiment and environment. A DRAGON’S TERRITORY The Field you are fighting in becomes your territory. When an enemy enters your territory, you have the option to make one attack against them, regardless of which range band they have entered, and which may not be boosted by any Knacks that allow you to make extra attacks. You use this ability even if you have already taken your action this round and may do so no matter how many enemies enter your divine territory, but you may only make one attack per enemy.

prophets.name: Prophets
prophets.description: Throughout history, there’ve been those that could see the paths beyond time itself and were driven to explore those possibilities.
prophets.mechanicalEffects: Throughout history, there’ve been those that could see the paths beyond time itself and were driven to explore those possibilities.

psychopomp.name: Psychopomp
psychopomp.description: The World is vast and the myriad paths that connect its Realms can be difficult to navigate, even for the Gods. Some Gods, however, excel at it, and for this reason are given the roles of heralds, messengers, and guides.
psychopomp.mechanicalEffects: The World is vast and the myriad paths that connect its Realms can be difficult to navigate, even for the Gods. Some Gods, however, excel at it, and for this reason are given the roles of heralds, messengers, and guides.

saint.name: Saint
saint.description: Saints are not chosen by the Gods, nor do they wield divine power. They are culture heroes, but they are not Heroes. They are human, quintessentially and completely. It is impossible for any Scion to ever have a Saint Knack by any means, including Followers Birthrights.

shepherd.name: Shepherd
shepherd.description: Shepherd Knacks have the power to choose a Ward and support them, allowing them to shrug off wounds or effects that would otherwise be debilitating, or Fatebind them with others with relative ease. These Knacks operate on the concepts of allyship and aid. Your ward may be a bandmate, if that player and your Storyguide both agree, but under most circumstances, they will be a Storyguide character.
